title: 1992 AMC 8 Problem 14
statement: When four gallons are added to a tank that is one-third full, the tank is then one-half full. The capacity of the tank in gallons is

solutions.text:
The \(4\) gallons account for the change from \(\dfrac13\) full to \(\dfrac12\) full, which is \(\dfrac12 - \dfrac13 = \dfrac16\) of the capacity.

If \(\dfrac16\) of the capacity is \(4\) gallons, the full capacity is \(4 \times 6 = 24\) gallons.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Adding \(4\) gallons raises the tank from \(\dfrac13\) full to \(\dfrac12\) full
So \(4\) gallons equals \(\dfrac12 - \dfrac13 = \dfrac16\) of the capacity
